source: سولي ماب مني جيم ماب3D اباه مرتب وكل شي اباه زي العاب المني جيم بلظبط اب في شوب وكوينز نقاط وابا في ادمن خاص فيني مايطلع الا لي وابا في قايمت الاعلانات يعني اكتب ويطلع لناس كتابتي وجنبه اسمي موثق وصورتي واب الادمن مرتب وفي خيارة كثير وفيها احداث ادمن بيوز وادمن بنل تكفى ظبطني وخلي اسم الماب بل انجليزي مني جيم

image_prompt.text: A prominent wall in the lobby sized to host the game's global points leaderboard
An out-of-play area where eliminated players wait and watch the rest of the round
Clearly marked transport points that move everyone from the lobby into the minigame stage
a tidy shop stall in the lobby with a counter where players spend their coins and points

layout_placement.text: Leaderboard surface driven by the game's points totals
Detection regions that register a point or a completed round
Lobby-to-stage transport at round start and back at round end

notes: The prompt never says which minigames are played, so the isolated stage has no specified content; P4 was taken on the strength of 'exactly like the minigame games'.
An owner-only admin panel with many options, admin events and an admin buzz feature are screen-space tools with no layout footprint.
The announcement feed - the owner types and every player sees the message with his verified name and avatar beside it - is also screen-space.
The map is to be named 'Mini Game' in English.

open_questions.ask: No look was described - should the map be bright and cartoon-coloured, or something more specific?
Which minigames should the stage host? It cannot be laid out without knowing what is played on it.

coverage_missing.ask: Which minigames run on the stage - obstacle rounds, tag, quiz, something else?
What should the map look like?
How many players should the lobby hold at once?

answers.ask: No look was described - should the map be bright and cartoon-coloured, or something more specific?
answers.answer: Make it bright and cartoon-coloured, with a clean polished Roblox minigame-game look.

answers.ask: Which minigames should the stage host? It cannot be laid out without knowing what is played on it.
answers.answer: Use a small set of classic minigames: Obby, Spleef, and a simple survival arena; keep the lobby compact and organized around these stages.
